<div class="card-body">
'''Officer Evax''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">イヴァックス参謀将校</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。デス・スターの位置カード上にいるなら、帝国軍の宇宙船は“リアクション”としてデス・スターの星系カードに移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Officer-Evax-PSA-90960098.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍情報部に属するリーダーで、反乱軍艦隊の進路を予想する正確な追跡情報を握っている。彼は巧みな宇宙船配備及び移動計画で、多くの基地の弱点を補ってきた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Officer Evax.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If he is on a Death Star location card, Imperial starships may move to the Death Star system card as a react.

'''Lore:'''
An Imperial Intelligence leader with accurate tracking data for predicting Rebel fleet courses. His skillful starship deployment and movement plans have covered the weaknesses of many bases.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is イヴァックス参謀将校.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Officer Evax]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
